description:
This protocol performs Syntehsize First Strand cDNA for the Illumina COVIDSeq protocol.
Links:
 1. Anneal RNA
 2. Synthesize First Strand cDNA
 3. Amplify cDNA
 4. Tagment PCR Amplicons
 5. Post Tagmentation Clean Up
 6. Amplify Tagmented Amplicons
